intro: The Tome of Divinity is a paladin quest in Stormwind where initiates provide linen cloth to Stephanie Turner, a caretaker watching over children orphaned by the Scourge. By assisting her in clothing the youths while her husband gathers supplies in Ironforge, the quest demonstrates the vital paladin virtue of selfless charity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bless their hearts, most of them have no families because of the Scourge attacks in the last decade.

My husband John collects the materials for me to make the shirts and pants for the children, but I haven't even had time to do that. I've been too focused on keeping food on their plates, and a roof over their heads.
What's that? You'd be willing to help? Oh, thank the Light, and thank you, friend.
If you could bring me some linen cloth so I can sew clothes for the kids, that would help me out so much.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope my John is having better luck in Ironforge. He so dislikes his trips there because it leaves the kids and me alone, but he knows it must be done. He's so kind-hearted.
Some years have been easier than others, but this one's been rougher by far. It's almost as though something in the air is signaling a huge change. Who knows though?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend, thank you so much!
The children will be so pleased, and you've saved me so much time. I'll now be able to focus on the children's other needs, and hopefully my John will be able to return home sooner than we thought.
Thank you again, friend. I knew I could rely on the charity of others. The Light be with you.
